name: Raymarching with Depth Buffer Occlusion
definition: A technique to allow raymarched distance field objects to occlude and be occluded by standard mesh-based objects by using the scene's depth buffer to limit the raymarch loop.
summary: Raymarching with Depth Buffer Occlusion enables SDF objects to correctly occlude and be occluded by standard meshes by querying the depth buffer to terminate rays early.
